name: Running analysis
trigger: new input to a running analysis (MAG breakdown, wave plan, cancel list)

steps.name: New input
steps.means: The client agent reads the new input (a file, an email, a meeting) and says whether the workbook needs regenerating.

steps.name: Ben rules on the input
steps.means: Only if the input raised choices: Ben rules on them; earlier rulings may settle some.
steps.gate: Ben rules on what the input read raised; precedent may settle covered items

sla.why: refit to p75 of 40 observed stays (2026-11-15; Ben 2026-11-15)

steps.name: Regenerate workbook
steps.means: The client agent rebuilds the workbook with the new input, as one workbook.

steps.name: Review
steps.means: A fresh agent checks the workbook against its checklist.

steps.name: Ben rules
steps.means: Ben rules on the rows that need him; earlier rulings may settle some.
steps.gate: per-row rulings; precedent may settle covered rows (build step 6)

sla.why: refit to p75 of 20 observed stays (2026-11-15; Ben 2026-11-15)

steps.name: Apply rulings
steps.means: The client agent applies Ben's rulings to the workbook.

steps.name: Ben uses the result
steps.means: Ben sends, presents or acts on the finished workbook; that closes the case.
steps.gate: Ben sends, presents or rules on what the applied result raised

sla.why: refit to p75 of 49 observed stays (2026-11-15; Ben 2026-11-15)
